nodes.label: Ack-aware OpcClient realtime methods
nodes.rationale: connect()/subscribeRoom()/unsubscribeRoom()/sendText() return Promise<void> resolving on CONNACK/SUBACK/UNSUBACK/PUBACK and rejecting on auth/ACL failure, while errors still surface via events.emit('error'). Backward compatible: fire-and-forget callers ignoring the return value are unaffected.

nodes.label: SDK public npm release and rename to @logact-pub/opc-sdk
nodes.rationale: Renamed from @opc/sdk for npm publishing; ServerEvent types now come from @logact-pub/opc-protocol instead of opc-core; EventBus uses bare 'events' import so it resolves to the Node builtin or the RN/Metro polyfill (same as mqtt.js), preparing for React Native consumption.
